item.title: I Found a $90k Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Google
item.description: A Flask cookie on developers.google.com was signed with a secret it was also carrying inside itself. Pulling that secret out turned a forged session into code execution across seven Google domains. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)
